name: 02035 · Foxboro, MA
findings: ZIP 02035 (Foxboro) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02035 (Foxboro) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02035 (Foxboro) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
